name: Of Tales and Deeds
summary:
Of Tales and Deeds is a turn-based sandbox RPG. There's no main quest pushing you along. Just a world full of people, towns, roads, and stories that unfold as you play.

Everyone you meet has a life of their own. The blacksmith goes to work in the morning, visits the tavern at night, and might remember that you helped his sister. Someone who sees you stealing might tell the neighbours. People talk, remember things, and react to what happens around them.
